title: Who will win the men's javelin throw gold medal at the 2026 Asian Games?
background: The Asian Games include separate men's and women's javelin throw competitions.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : The official Asian Games final results, corroborated by contemporaneous reporting from Al Jazeera. 
  Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the athlete awarded the gold medal at the conclusion of the men's javelin throw final at the 2026 Asian Games. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The athlete's full name.
